zh: 按產品驗收 SOP 對全套生活金融工具及智能計算器進行角色對抗、手機介面、獨立公式、海報／分析書和可選 AI 渠道檢查；保留所有原始案例並新增不可接受輸入、切換類別、狹窄螢幕及鍵盤回歸。
修正拼句式智能計算的邊界：不得以 0／負數準備期或年期、超出有效範圍的年齡或 100% 以上風險比例產生結果；同時檢查供款年數與等待期、退休年齡與現齡、預期壽命與退休年齡的矛盾。允許有意義的負回報與明示的永久領取假設。
原有逐題問卷同步套用數值邊界驗證，避免改用另一入口就繞過檢查；出錯時保留用戶數值並顯示錯誤。
修復真實 Chrome Web 驗收工具：新版 Flutter 的詞塊以無障礙標籤暴露，數字鍵盤需選中原有例子值後輸入；測試覆蓋本金調整、計算、獨立複利核對、海報預覽及圖片／PDF 分享選單。
保留 DeepSeek 自帶金鑰的僅會話保存、離線本地計算及所有舊海報；同步改正 README 過時的自由文字輸入及離線描述。詳細記錄見 docs/reviews/2026-10-27-full-product-acceptance.md。
en: Audited the calculator suite with adversarial personas, mobile UI, independent formulas, actual rendering and optional AI-channel mock tests, retaining all existing regression cases.

Blocked impossible zero/negative horizons, invalid ages, percentages beyond 100%, and contradictory funding/wait and retirement/lifespan assumptions in the fixed-slot composer. Legitimate negative historical returns and explicitly perpetual payouts remain valid.
Applied the same numeric validation to advanced question-by-question flows to prevent bypassing checks through an alternate entry path.

Repaired real Chrome UI QA for Flutter ActionChip accessible labels and numeric fields with an existing example value. Browser QA now edits principal, checks the independent annuity calculation, previews posters and inspects image/PDF share formats.
Corrected outdated documentation about the replaced freeform input and optional DeepSeek connectivity. API keys remain session-only; local formulas are unchanged.
